content: Vikram Patel from Omni Insurance Group called Sneha Roy to discuss the upcoming expiration of her health policy (HP-4478) on September 30, 2026. Sneha initially expressed concern over the increased premium of $210 per month (up from $190). Vikram checked and applied a 5% loyalty discount, reducing the new monthly premium to $199.50. Sneha agreed to proceed with the renewal, and Vikram confirmed he would send the renewal documents via email.

action_items: Send renewal documents via email to the customer
